about: Common bike parts approved by beenster (stages 1-8b), one GLB per part: one mesh, one primitive per surface, +Y up, metres, origin at the mount point; looks JSON as build3d.export_game. Each file is the part as fitted on its lead bike (fitted_on); the script refits it to any bike. Not in Data/ until the switch-over is agreed.
axes: Blender +x forward, +y rider's left, +z up, written with export_yup like the bikes; mount_mm is the mount point on the lead bike in the bike's own mm (x from the rear axle line, z from the ground)

mounts.bar_clamp: the bar clamp centre on the top yoke risers (on the steering axis plane, y 0)
mounts.top_yoke: the top yoke centre where the fork tubes end (y 0)
mounts.rider_peg: the rider's footpeg point on the centre line (y 0); the pair stands either side
mounts.shock_top: the shock's top eye (y 0 for a twin pair)
mounts.can_inlet: the middle of the silencer inlet(s) where the pipe slips in (y 0 for a pair)
mounts.cap_base: the middle of the cap's foot on the tank
mounts.part_centre: the middle of the part (y 0 when it is a left and right pair)

moves_with.steering: turns with the bars and fork
moves_with.shock: spans frame to swingarm: stretches with the suspension

chains.note: Chains are finishes of the bike's own chain (a material swap), so they have no file.
